ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Network Connection To Notion API
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a non-browser process communicating with the Notion API. This could indicate potential use of a covert C2 channel such as "OffensiveNotion C2" Note: Unmapped fields: DestinationHostname

sequences.query: DestinationHostname = RGX(".*api\\\.notion\\\.com.*") AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Programs\\\\Notion\\\\Notion\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\brave\\\.exe$") OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome\.exe") OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Mozilla\ Firefox\\firefox\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Mozilla\ Firefox\\firefox\.exe") OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Internet\ Explorer\\iexplore\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Internet\ Explorer\\iexplore\.exe") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\maxthon\\\.exe$") OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeWebView\\\\Application\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\WindowsApps\\\\MicrosoftEdge\\\.exe$") OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge\.exe")) OR ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeCore\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeCore\\\\")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedgewebview2\\\.exe$"))) OR process_path = RGX("\\\\opera\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\safari\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\seamonkey\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\vivaldi\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\whale\\\.exe$"))
